Lanteris Space LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of Intuitive Machines, is currently seeking an entry-level Software Development Engineer to join our team in San Jose, CA, or a US remote location. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing software for spacecraft simulators that are used by internal and external customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate to begin their career in the space industry working on cutting-edge simulation technology.

 

Intuitive Machines is a leading space infrastructure company that builds spacecraft, connects networks, and operates infrastructure-as-a-service for commercial, civil, and national security customers. With a proven track record across the space domain, the Company, through organic growth and portfolio expansion, has built over 300 spacecraft, delivered over 260 kilograms of payload to the lunar surface, and provided precision navigation expertise that has guided spacecraft across our solar system.

 

Responsibilities

Design and implement models of spacecraft components and/or subsystems for all-software spacecraft simulators
Learn and apply spacecraft hardware specifications, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and technical documentation to develop accurate software models
Adhere to current satellite and software industry best practices
Deploy code through existing Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines
Collaborate with team members to find solutions to design and evaluate technical trade-offs
Communicate cross-functionally with software and systems engineers to ensure a coherent system design
Write and perform unit, integration, and system-level tests on software applications
Participate in customer-facing design reviews and other technical discussions

Minimum Requirements

Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Aerospace Engineering, or related disciplines, or degree received within 3 months of hire date 
Proficiency with Linux or demonstrated ability to learn quickly
Familiarity with software compilers and other software development tools
Experience (academic or professional) in the following:
Developing software in C++ or Python
Debugging and troubleshooting software systems
Software development best practices
Version control systems (Git)

Preferred Qualifications

Strong applied mathematics skills, including numerical methods, linear algebra, differential equations, and/or computational physics
Experience implementing mathematical algorithms in software (coursework projects, research, or professional work)
Academic projects involving simulation, modeling, or real-time systems
Relevant internship or co-op experience in software development, aerospace, or simulation
Coursework or project experience with object-oriented programming and software design patterns
Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking concepts
Exposure to Agile methodologies or modern software development practices
Familiarity with automated testing frameworks
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to learn quickly and multi-task in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment
Passion to work on space applications
Interest in spacecraft systems, operations, design, or testing
Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

What We Offer

Mentorship from experienced engineers in spacecraft simulation and systems engineering
Hands-on experience with real spacecraft hardware and flight software
Opportunity to work on projects that directly support space missions
Professional development and growth opportunities in the aerospace industry

In support of pay transparency at Lanteris Space Systems, we disclose salary ranges on all U.S. job postings.  The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the salary range provided below and is determined based on job-related factors, including, but not limited to, the experience, qualifications, knowledge, skills, geographic work location, and market conditions. Candidates with the minimum necessary experience, qualifications, knowledge, and skillsets for the position should not expect to receive the upper end of the pay range.

● The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $66,000.00 - $111,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $66,000.00 - $111,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $66,000.00 - $111,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within California is: $77,000.00 - $128,000.00 annually.

For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, health and welfare insurance, and 401(k) to eligible employees. More information on our benefits will be shared with candidates as they move forward in the recruitment process.

The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.  If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. 

The date of posting can be found on the Lanteris Space Systems Career page at the top of each job posting.

To apply, submit your application via the Lanteris Space Systems Career page.
